packageRules.description: TypeScript 7 is the native (Go) port which does not yet expose the full compiler API used by @typescript-eslint, ts-jest, ts-loader and ts-node. #1697 auto-merged the v7 bump and broke the lint stage on master (ESLint crash: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading Cjs)'). Hold on v6 until the toolchain supports the native port.
HDPI-9884: upgrade the Azure Monitor distro and the @opentelemetry packages in one PR, so their versions stay in step.
HDPI-9884: 0.70+ needs a newer @opentelemetry/instrumentation than the 0.221 that @azure/monitor-opentelemetry 1.20.x uses and resolutions pins. Raise this when the distro is upgraded.
